title: Flashback: the Khan's gold tablet
place: The court of Kublai Khan, 1266 (Polo, Book 1 ch. 2-7: the brothers' first journey).

layout.status: Draft blocking for the storyboard (Nov 26 2026); distances are a first proposal.
layout.light: warm daylight from tall doors on the south side (bottom of the map)

landmarks.label: the Khan's raised throne
landmarks.note: on a low dais at the north end of the hall

camera.framing: Wide, from the doors, eye level

cells.action: Down the long hall, Niccolò and Maffeo kneel before Kublai Khan on his raised throne; courtiers line both sides.

where.niccolo: the kneeling man on the left
where.maffeo: the kneeling man on the right
where.kublai: the seated ruler on the throne at the far end

cells.action: Kublai Khan leans forward on his throne, curious about these two Latin merchants.
A courtier lays a gold tablet in Niccolò's open hands; Maffeo kneels beside him, watching.

where.niccolo: the man receiving the tablet, on the right
where.maffeo: the man on the left, beside him

cells.action: The gold tablet in Niccolò's hands: a long plaque engraved with Mongol script, a hole for its cord.
